items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Tick Grey, got a little group together, and we went out to like a roadhouse type thing

ctx.x: Oh, and incidentally, ladies and gentlemen, during those years I met Milt Hinton, and we used to rehearse every day. We would get together and have our little sessions every day. Finally, one day -- what was Tick's real name?
